label: Arroyo et al. (2010)
units: PGA, PSA in g at the API boundary; the model's own units and log base are kept under parameters
validityScope: Single-site intensity only; no spatial correlation, so never use it to draw a correlated field across multiple assets. Valid only inside its own published magnitude, distance, period and damping envelope, recorded under parameters; outside it the wrapper refuses unless the caller sets allow_extrapolation. Not usable at version 0.1.0: coefficients are anchor_only - one anchor branch (PGA / headline branch) is reproducible from the specification appendix, but the spectral table and a median kernel are not in the repository - so construction raises CoefficientsUnavailable and no capability is declared. What is missing is named under parameters.coefficients.needed.

source.catalogue: Douglas, J. (2011). Ground-motion prediction equations 1964-2010. PEER Report 2011/102 / BRGM/RP-59356-FR.
source.benchmark_spec: gmpe_30_coding_prompts.md, sections 3 and 4 - the 30-family benchmark set definition.
source.caveat: Douglas (2011) is a catalogue, not a ranking, and warns that a report of its size may contain errors or omissions. Every envelope below is its summary, frequently approximate. Nothing here substitutes for the original publication.
source.coefficient_appendix: gmpe_30_coding_prompts_with_coefficients.md sections 11 and 12 - coefficients transcribed from Douglas (2011), with an explicit per-model completeness status and a coefficient-completeness gate.

parameters.label: Arroyo et al. (2010)

site.note: Resolve the calibration site condition from the paper.
site.anchor_note: The PGA anchor carries no site term, so the anchor branch is a single site condition. Which condition is not stated - read it off the paper before using the model.

coefficients.needed: The SPECTRAL alpha(T) table. PGA/headline coefficients (alpha1-alpha4, b), the finite-source radius and the full aleatory decomposition are now available.

implementation_notes: Attenuation uses exponential-integral terms - use a numerically stable special-function implementation (scipy.special).
Numerical tests at very small and very large arguments, to catch cancellation and overflow.
parameters.reason_for_inclusion: Mexican interface model with physically motivated attenuation form.

resolution_provenance.component: OpenQuake hazardlib (gem/oq-engine master, retrieved 2026-10-04), openquake/hazardlib/gsim/arroyo_2010.py: 'geometric average of the maximum component of the two horizontal' (IMC.GEOMETRIC_MEAN). Douglas codes the component U (unknown), so this rests on the external implementation alone.
resolution_provenance.site.condition: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, section 2.279: all data from rock (NEHRP B) sites, verified with H/V ratios
resolution_provenance.periods.grid: OpenQuake hazardlib (gem/oq-engine master, retrieved 2026-10-04), openquake/hazardlib/gsim/arroyo_2010.py coefficient table; period count and range (56 periods, 0.04-5 s) match Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table). External implementation, original paper not checked.

parameters.component_warning: Douglas (2011) lists the component as unknown; 'geometric_mean' comes from OpenQuake's reading of the paper. Confirm before comparing against other models.
